cases.name: Robin Lynn Ashford
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Robin was a courageous, free-spirited, free-hearted, loving woman. She wasn't afraid to let anyone know how much she loved The Most High. She was the type of person who could walk into a dark space and make it bright and fill it with life. She believed in helping others, even if it was just to give them a simple prayer of hope. There was so much comfort and joy in Robin's smile. No matter what situation was going on, she would find a silver lining. She embodied what it was to be a strong woman. Her confidence was inspirational. She made everywhere she went her catwalk. Robin put her mark on Killeen. So many people have beautiful memories of her. She will forever be loved by many and missed by all."

cases.name: Kisha Gaither Gates
cases.about:
“Kisha was Kisha,” (her daughter) Rosie said softly, describing her mother as “beautiful, smart, fierce, and fashionable.” Gates was known throughout Central Texas for her generosity and vibrant spirit. “She always put others first,” her daughter said. “She was a woman I inspired to be like.”

Her obituary said, "She was a devoted daughter, mother, sister, fashion mogul, and child of God whose presence illuminated every room she entered. A woman of extraordinary strength and grace, Kisha was a three-time cancer survivor whose resilience inspired all who knew her. Her faith and courage guided her through every challenge, and she dedicated much of her life to supporting cancer research and awareness campaigns.

Kisha was a creative powerhouse; the founder of Vision of Fashion, known for her unmatched eye for style, creative directing, and wardrobe expertise. She graced Paris Fashion Week and collaborated with celebrated designers, including Timeekah Murphy of Alani Taylor, whose work has been seen on icons like Beyonce. Her influence extended far beyond the runway; she embodied elegance, confidence, and empowerment.

Outside of fashion Kisha expressed her love through food, running her own catering business, Boujee Foodie, where every dish reflected her warmth, creativity and flair. She was also a top nominee for Fab Over 40, a recognition of her beauty, brilliance, and power to inspire women everywhere."
